exceptions.finding: A binding names its scale (Binding.scale) by id, plugin scales included; the reading build must still have that scale.
node.shape, underlayShape, overlayShape and encode choices name built-in node shapes by id.
Arrowheads, edge.style and edge.outlineStyle name built-in arrowheads and line patterns by id.
An overflow policy (overflow: shape or pattern) steps through fixed lists in encoding.ts that the file does not carry; changing a list changes old files' drawings.

Border styles, chart kinds, stripe directions, route, support model, image fit and repeat, model fit, center and up axis are closed lists saved by name, with no catalog table; the scan does not list their ids yet.
layoutTransition in the configuration names a transition preset by id (glide).
A node model saved as asset:sample/<name> names a shipped sample by name, and embedding one is refused.
A project's data source names a generator or dataset by name, resolved against the current generator catalog.
The Starting, Ghost and Pinned rows carry template ids that code branches on.
Saved runs, run-on-load entries and filter measure leaves name an algorithm by key and run it again on open.
The layout is saved by id and engine and run again on open, plus the legacy layoutBehavior.type.
A map layout names its basemap by MapSourceId, and no map means the bundled world image.
A binding naming no palette paints with the build's default (ylorbr, okabe-ito), which the file does not record.
Settings equal to the default are omitted from the file and filled from the reader's defaults, so a changed default changes old files.
startingRows, editableBase and runPlacement are not saved, and the app reapplies them.
Graphviz edge routes are not saved; they are computed again on open.
Place names are looked up at a graphty.app URL when the layout reruns, so the file depends on that service.
Saved runs match data by an unversioned FNV-1a hash; a change to the hash orphans every saved run.

Not a dependency: the data member's own encoding tag (format json, dialect node-link), which projectFile.ts reads itself without the format catalog. Listed so that any other place a save names a format fails the scan.

notSaved.shaderLibrary: part of the graphty-shader 1 format, which carried text calls; shader-library.test.ts snapshots it
notSaved.cameras: camera presets are commands that move the camera; a saved view holds the camera's numbers, never a preset id
notSaved.screenshotPresets: settings for one capture; nothing a file saves names a preset
